entity_raw.definition_raw:
The repulsive horror of your smothering attack nearly incapacitates most foes.

Prerequisite(s): Engulf Revulsion; engulf or smother universal monster ability.

Benefit(s): When you successfully engulf or smother an opponent, successfully maintain a grapple combat maneuver on a smothered opponent, the opponent must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Strength modifier) or become staggered for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
